# PDF memo template. Knitting to PDF requires LaTeX. To install TinyTeX, run
# install.packages("tinytex") and then tinytex::install_tinytex() in the
# console, and restart RStudio. If you can't install TinyTeX, use
# memo_html.Rmd instead.
output:
  pdf_document:
    includes:
      in_header: memo_preamble.tex
fontsize: 12pt
geometry: margin=1in
params:
  to: "Councilmember, Seattle City Council"
  from: "Your Name, Office of Planning and Community Development"
  date: !r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")
  re: "Short-term rental listings in the Seattle area"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# Page setup lives in memo_preamble.tex; the header layout lives in memo_header.tex;
# figure options (wrap, wrap.width) are explained in memo_setup.R
source("memo_setup.R")
```

```{r data, include = FALSE}
# Replace this chunk with your own data
airbnb <- read_csv("https://bit.ly/3oadz2L", show_col_types = FALSE)

n_listings <- nrow(airbnb)

# Descriptive statistics to report in the text with inline R code
price_stats <- airbnb |>
  summarise(
    mean   = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd     = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    min    = min(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    max    = max(price, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

share_entire <- mean(airbnb$room_type == "Entire home/apt")
n_rated      <- sum(!is.na(airbnb$rating))
mean_rating  <- mean(airbnb$rating, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r header, echo = FALSE}
memo_header(params)
```

## Analysis

```{r listings-plot, echo = FALSE, wrap = "right", wrap.width = 0.45, fig.width = 4, fig.height = 2.8}
airbnb |>
  count(address, room_type) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = reorder(address, n, sum), fill = room_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Listings", y = NULL, fill = NULL, title = "Listings by city and room type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title.position = "plot")
```

```{r price-table, echo = FALSE}
airbnb |>
  group_by(City = address) |>
  summarise(
    Listings = n(),
    `Entire home (%)` = round(100 * mean(room_type == "Entire home/apt")),
    `Median nightly price ($)` = median(price, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(Listings)) |>
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Listings and prices by city")
```
